reviews.title: Beware of sneaky Auto renew
reviews.text: Do not trust this app or company. They charged me for an annual membership without email notification because I signed up on the website instead of through the app. They will not refund the charges. They would have continued to charge me unknowingly if they hadn’t sent me an email to upgrade.

reviews.title: Cancelled in 2023. Have taken money for the last 2 years
reviews.text:
Update 2026 - have just received an email ahead of a charge abut to be taken from my accounts despite getting a refund for the 2025 one and asking them to Cancel-Cancel and stop this stupidness as I cancelled this in 2023 and I’m still getting attempts to take money out.

-  have seen other reviews saying the same.

There is clearly an issue in regard to the instruction sent through the Apple subscriptions to cancel your Asana Rebel continue to remove payments at their end. 

I have taken multiple screenshots showing that the email link they sent as a generic response to any received emails, is broken.

Upon logging in, I was instantly asked to re-download the app proving that I don’t already have it on board My phone. 

Paypal shows two consecutive years of payments despite me cancelling two years ago after a trial price for a whole year. 

There are no payments or services linked to Asana Rebel onto my Apple account so this is them acting without Apple information. 

I fully expect a refund for the payments that have been taken without any permission for 2024 and 2025.

reviews.title: Poorly laid out app, not easy to navigate and does not sync with Apple Watch well
reviews.text: Super dissatisfied with app, a lot of features just don’t work like playing your own music for workouts. Additionally many of the videos are not synced well with Audio, the audio is a good 10sec ahead of what the person in the video is doing.

reviews.title: Annoyed
reviews.text: Very difficult to cancel subscription.

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Much better apps out there, and no refunds once paid on this platform even though they never invest in new content. After a while you have exhausted what is on the platform. Better to find a local health club that offers more.

reviews.title: Beware of unauthorized charges
reviews.text: Unethical charges and doesn’t cancel when notified to cancel. Doesn’t show up under subscriptions and refused to refund and cancel subscription when initially asked.  Not easy to cancel and overpriced

reviews.title: Son abusivos y ventajosos
reviews.text: La App es básica y no reúne las características con las que se promueve, la cancelé hace 2 años y cada año intentan hacer el cobro de la anualidad, no se si lo hacen por su carente administración o por abuso y creen que el usuario no se dará cuenta del cobro, tengan cuidado, hay mejores App que reúnen más servicios y a menor precio, ASANA no tiene ética

reviews.title: I am requesting a full refund for the charge
reviews.text:
Dear Customer Support Team,

I am writing to formally dispute recurring charges for an application that I purchased only once and cancelled afterward. I no longer use this app, and it does not appear in my list of active subscriptions or apps; however, I continue to be charged every year without my authorization.

I reported this issue last year, but despite my previous complaint, I was charged again this year. I did not authorize this renewal, and I request an immediate investigation into why these charges continue to occur.

I am requesting a full refund for the charge that was recently made to my account, as this renewal was not authorized and the cancellation had already been requested previously. I also request that you immediately cancel any existing subscription associated with my account, ensure that no future charges will be processed, and provide written confirmation that this issue has been resolved.

I would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and confirmation once the refund and cancellation have been completed.

Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
Coraly Hernandez

reviews.title: Lifetime member
reviews.text: Even restoring purchase as I have grandfathered in the lifetime as an early buyer of the app, now even after they say have full access, I have limited access to the content compared to what they used to offer.

reviews.title: Can’t Cancel
reviews.text:
I have tried numerous times to cancel my subscription but absolutely no customer service. 
Just had another years subscription go out of my Bank via PayPal. Had to cancel further payments on PayPal and raise a dispute because the contact email kept bouncing back. 
If you intend to join for life fill your boots otherwise leave WELL ALONE.

reviews.title: Cancelled subscription yet charged!
reviews.text: I had subscribed to the app a year ago but didn’t use the app after two or three trials. I noticed on my bank account that I had been debited £102.99 for a 24-month plan whilst I had cancelled my subscription. I didn’t even show on my list of outstanding subscriptions. Emailed them today having noticed the debit and went on the app. Answered a few questions and nothing else. Not fair as they have access to PayPal account unlawfully debiting clients accounts.

reviews.title: Also illegally renewed!
reviews.text: I’ve seen other people complain of this and my subscription has also been illegally renewed despite ending my subscription. I’ll now need to claim my £102 back through PayPal.

reviews.title: Cancel subscription
reviews.text: Cancelled my annual subscription three months in. Since it was an annual I was able to use the remaining months that I had paid for. I was just charged again for another annual subscription. When I go to the app it shows that I do not currently have a membership. There is a button that says cancel anytime however the hyperlink doesn’t work. Likely because i don’t have an active subscription. There is no way to contact anyone directly. I googled how to cancel. Found several landing pages that went nowhere. Eventually came across two separate emails tied to the company. I sent an email to both explaining the situation. I get back well we don’t see an active membership on our end. Check the app, check google play, check PayPal and lastly check your apple subscriptions. It was none of these mind you, needless to say no accountability so now I’m dealing with my bank. Just beware if you’re considering signing up there may be recurring charges that show up unauthorized.

reviews.title: Took £102.99 for a renewal and refuse to refund
reviews.text: Check out trust pilot before taking out a trial of this app.  Lot of very unhappy people who are being refused a refund as it’s not Asana’s policy. Their policy is to say they sent out a reminder (they do NOT) charge you for a further year you can’t use and refuse a refund. Avoid

reviews.title: Scam Recharge
reviews.text:
Zero stars 
My best advice is: Do not download app! Do not give them any type of credit card information-unless you want to be charged for the rest of your life.   
Seriously! 
I Canceled my membership a full year ago. 
Today out of the blue they charged me again. Even though I have not used the app in 365 days &  I have a confirmation of it being canceled.
No help via customer serviced either.  There is No customer phone number to call -just an email from a bot saying ‘our subscription is clear-you will be charged’. 
I am SURE they can see that: 
1) I cancelled the membership 1 year ago
2)There has been   NO activity on this app. 
It is an  utter theft of your money.

reviews.title: Nope
reviews.text: App is glitchy and very suspicious. Lots of trackers. I do not recommend

reviews.title: Not the best and Zero customer service
reviews.text: I have been a subscriber for six years. I have stopped using the app because the content was rarely updated and was focused more on lifestyle than yoga. I had thought that I had cancelled my subscription as I was unable to use it. To my surprise, it automatically renewed. I complained and pointed out that I have not used it for a very long time and had not received an email to say it was being renewed. Customer service team rebuffed me continually. Even when I pointed out that I could get six months free as a new Subscriber. I have never received such poor customer service, particularly after being such a long-standing customer. I would not recommend this app because it looks expensive and there are now better options available. Shame on your Asana Rebel customer service. Both myself and my partner have cancelled our subscriptions and have shared our views with others.

reviews.title: Dreadful - unauthorised renewal of subscription
reviews.text: Do not - I repeat do not be fooled by the twinkly music & pretty models with health juices… this app will re authorise your subscription without any warning or alert in your phone & then refuse to refund even when you haven’t used it for months. Appalling. Do not sign up or get fooled.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: After the last update it doesn’t work on iPhone anymore. There is no button to start the exercise. It disappears.

reviews.title: Untrustworthy
reviews.text: Like many other, as I have discovered online, Asana is not a reliable company- I cancelled my subscription more than a year ago and they have taken money for renewal, when I mentioned this to them on the day- they refuse to reimburse. Very worrying that they have kept my personal details and bank details. Be careful.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: I logged in with Apple, paid for a subscription, it logged me out and deleted all my progress. I tried to log in with my email on my iPad, and won’t let me. So I can’t use the app across multiple devices. Contacting Apple to get my money back.

reviews.title: Avoid

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Don’t fall for the ads. Workouts are basic and not doing to change your body. Customer service is awful. The whole things feels like a bad fitness/health AI platform.

reviews.title: Rip Off
reviews.text: Absolute rip-off! Not worth the price or the aggravation when trying to cancel a subscription.

reviews.title: Cancelling sucks
reviews.text: You can on cancel the day before your anniversary of superscription.  24 hrs or you are stuck w/ the cost.

reviews.title: Class action law suit 2025
reviews.text: .  Cancelling subscriptions through the App Store does NOT stop billing. They bill yearly, silently, even after the subscription is canceled. Contact them directly and dispute the charge on your card.

reviews.title: Hidden Subscription Renewal
reviews.text: I am so angry with this app and the developers. They have chosen to hide the subscription renewal within the website. Not the Apple subscription services tab. A total scam way of handling people who want to cancel their subscription. A very dishonest way of doing business. Do not get suckered like I did.

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: Avoid at all costs! Cheap sign up then a year later without any notification will take £102.99 from your account! Will not give a penny back even though no renewal notice ever sent. Complete scam!

reviews.title: absolute scam of an app
reviews.text:
AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!! this app will charge a renewal fee of over £100 without any warning or reminder and will refuse to give a refund 

apart from the above scam teh actual workouts are not engaging hence why i had stopped using it and had forgotten it was ever on my phone, which is exactly what they want!

reviews.title: BUYER BEWARE
reviews.text: If I could give negative reviews I would. I tried this app and it was very meh. Canceled my subscription and here we are a year later and they have tried to charge my card 5 plus times even after I have emailed them each time and told them to quit. They acknowledged my account is not active but yet they continue to try to charge me. DO NOT SIGN UP. THEY WILL CONTINUE TO CHARGE YOU LONG AFTER YOU CANCEL. BUYER BEWARE

reviews.title: False advertising - they’re refusing to refund despite clearly stated 2 week offer
reviews.text:
They’re lying about letting people try the app for 2 weeks for free. It’s actually a 13 day free trial. If you try to cancel on the 14th day, they’ll tell you “it’s outside the 14 day eligibility window” and refuse to refund your money. 
The email conversation trying to resolve this has been so bizarre it’s like they have ai chatbots doing their customer support. 
I’m not sure what the stand for as a company, but it’s none of the ethos of yoga.

reviews.title: Don’t expect help
reviews.text: Once they charge you. They don’t care to help. I politely asked for a pro rated refund as I had the renewal date wrong. And I admitted to that. I Havent used the app in months. And with the unrest in my home state of MN I lost track of regular life. They didn’t care.  I asked for a refund for the rest of the year discounting the first month. No. Since 14 days had passed. So despite my multiple years of service. They could Care less, and provided zero customer service or care. What kind of personal care are they providing?  They just want our money.

reviews.title: Attempted payment again and again
reviews.text: I have been in touch with customer service over the $119 charge renewal - it has been tried on my card 4 different times. In two different email chains they have PROMISED my account was deleted and it  wouldn’t happen again and I just got another attempted charge here. FIX THIS!!!

reviews.title: BEWARE!!

reviews.title: Deceptive and incompetent subscription service
reviews.text: Asana Rebel must be going out of business because they sent me an email saying my annual renewal was $35.99 , charged me $72 and have me in an infinite loop where they ask me over and over the charge amount which I have sent at least 5 times and they just keep asking.  DO NOT SUBSCRIBE TO THIS SERVICE unless you want to subject to an infinite incompetent customer service loop to get a refund of their deceptive charges

reviews.title: App did not keep my interest, but the company kept my money
reviews.text: I signed up for this a year ago and did not find it compelling so I never used it. I then missed the cancellation date by less than 24 hours but they charged me for another full year and dismissed my request for leniency. I realize I should have cancelled earlier, but most companies are more forgiving. Do not waste your money.

reviews.title: Renews after cancellation. Stay away!!
reviews.text: Cancelled app and a year later it renews for $119.99. They agreed to cancel it again but will not refund money.

reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: Purchased a year ago, had shoulder injury as well as surgery. Canceled subscription yet was charged 119.99. When I reached out they said my subscription was never canceled. I never received any notification of upcoming renewal.They were only willing to provide me a 50% refund even though they can clearly see I haven’t been using the app.

reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text: I wanted to sign up for a monthly subscription, but they charge my card for a year at $36. Then, when it’s time for my yearly membership to renew, and I wanted to cancel, there was no way to do that, either within my Apple subscriptions app Nor through the Asana Rebel app. There was no link for an email or anything. After I complained to them for charging my card again for a yearly membership of $119, they stopped my automatic renewal but kept the money.

reviews.title: Dishonest Company
reviews.text:
If you intend on subscribing, you better hope you spend a lot of time in the app because if you forget it will renew you with no notice outside the app and they refuse to refund you, even minutes after the charge hits.

This developer response is insulting given the email responses I have received from them. They have absolutely no interest in righting any wrongs, nor getting any better.

reviews.title: Awful experience – do not subscribe
reviews.text:
I never used the service. I checked my Apple subscriptions and it did not appear there, so I reasonably assumed I was not subscribed. The subscription renewal email went to my junk folder.

As soon as the payment was taken, I contacted the company immediately to explain what had happened and request a refund. It then took a full month for them to reply, only to tell me this was my responsibility and that they would not refund the charge.

Very disappointing customer service and an extremely frustrating experience. I would not recommend.

reviews.title: Horrible Customer Service

reviews.title: Trying to cancel for years

Haven’t used this app since initially downloaded as it was rubbish. 
Without notification via email/text they have taken a years subscription and refuse to refund.

reviews.title: Borderline fraud
reviews.text:
I tried it out and paid a full year. It auto renewed without a notification and the same day I asked for cancellation and refund. They said that it cannot be processed as per their terms. 
The product is buggy, poor in quality and their customer success unprofessional. They plan to make money from people who forget to delete their accounts. Good luck to them

reviews.title: Difficult to cancel
reviews.text: I’ve been using the app for few years and I liked it. I did all the challenges and there is nothing new and challenging for me anymore I tried to cancel and I couldn’t because I switched to iPhone and don’t have access to my old google account. Tried customer support but it keeps glitching. Left it for later when I have more time. Then I got charged $119.99 for the renewal . I sent an email and finally got to cancel but I don’t get a refund, because of their policy…I found the email in my spam folder… how I’m I suppose to see it? Now I’m stuck paying for an app that I’m not going use. VERY DISAPPOINTED.

reviews.title: Don’t subscribe!!!
reviews.text: After reading MANY of the comments I understood that this has happened to many of the users! After somehow ending downloading their app through their heavy use of ads on popular platforms and mistakenly authorising a one year subscription which never happened before-I cancelled the service straight away in apple so I don’t forget although I l re it would still run for a year - but never used it because actually their app is not as straightforward as they claim to be! A year later they try charge me over £100 without prior notice! The audacity! Luckily my bank asked me if I authorise the payment first and obviously I didn’t and reported for fraudulent attempt to charge me. AVOID THEM!!!!!

reviews.title: Charged without notice, refund refused
reviews.text:
I was charged for an annual renewal, a substantial amount, without notice. I hadn’t actively used the app in at least six months, and contacted customer support within moments of being alerted of the charge. Despite the immediate response and explanation of our family’s circumstances, my refund request was flatly denied.

For a company that markets mindfulness and personal growth, this rigid and profit-driven response shows little concern for users. 

Buyer beware, they won’t notify you before a charge, and they won’t help you when that unexpected charge comes through.

reviews.title: Unauthorized charges
reviews.text: I downloaded this app to see its features but never used it not authorized payment. It’s not even showing in my subscriptions. Today I was charged $119.99, not once but twice. How is this possible? This is not acceptable. Please refund 2x $119.99 immediately.

reviews.title: Don’t fall for it!
reviews.text: The app is buggy and workouts are boring- not yoga at all. The videos don’t track completion properly, so when you’re doing a series it won’t allow you to move forward. Don’t fall for the intro price, it’s $119, which is ludicrous

reviews.title: Won’t refund even when I didn’t authorize
reviews.text:
I joined a year ago, bought a year subscription, used it a few times and deleted the app. I knew I paid for a year, I knew I was out the money.  I was 100% sure I did not sign up for auto renewal.  Well…they just charged my card for another year.  I reached out the day the withdrawal hit my account.  They said they wouldn’t do anything about it because they sent me an email letting me know it would be renewing. 
If a company has to give you a million reasons why they are in the right for not refunding your money, I don’t want any part of that company. They offered to give me 6 months free. I guess they weren’t listening when I told them I used the app and wasn’t impressed. I don’t want 6 months “free” so they can have the opportunity to charge my card again. 
I feel like they are dishonest and GREEDY.

reviews.title: hidden payment
reviews.text: be careful- it takes £100 hidden payment

reviews.title: god help us all
reviews.text: get out while you can. I haven't been charged crazy the way other people have but i could see that happening. This entire thing is AI... it's so creepy. I just did my first yoga lesson and it's completely AI...dystopian. horrifying. And they have AI responses to these reviews and I wouldn't be surprised if the whole thing was just invented by a robot. Really scary. canceling now..if they let me.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your money on this
reviews.text: Just awful. The adverts look great, and do not reflect reality. Very sparse, very basic content. Avoid.

reviews.title: They refuse to let you cancel a subscription
reviews.text: Yoga is fine, but they make it really hard to cancel a subscription and do not alert you to the fact that they’re going to charge you. When you reach out to them, they ignore you. It’s unacceptable for subscription services like this to behave this way. Sketchy company with sketchy policies, steer clear.

reviews.title: Will NOT let me cancel subscription
reviews.text: I have been trying to cancel my subscription for over a year now. I thought I accomplished it and deleted the app from my phone, but I have just been charged again. I can’t get anyone to actually help  me and will be going to the BBB about this situation. If I could give zero stars, I would.

reviews.title: Nothing like the advertisement
reviews.text: Only for young, overly fit individuals who like rigorous movements. I do not see any of the exercises that are advertised. I feel scammed and there is no refund unfortunately.

reviews.title: Charged after canceling
reviews.text: I cancelled this subscription over a year ago and they charged me for it again this year. Now they claim they can’t find any account associated with me and are refusing to refund the money they STOLE from me.

reviews.title: Ok for the first year
reviews.text:
This app is mediocre in terms of yoga. It will aggressively remind you to do workouts if you select that. 
The first year is pretty cheap, but they are sneaky with their auto-renewal. It does NOT show up in your Apple subscriptions. They auto renew completely on their own and you have to email them to cancel. I had a problem with them receiving my emails, even though I sent several and missed the “14 day refund policy”. They told me they were being generous in refunding half of the $78 they charged me and cancelling my access immediately. 
There’s better apps with more honest policies and better workouts. I suggest Playbook or the Apple fitness app over this one. Don’t fall for the fancy marketing.

reviews.title: No autorenewal warning
reviews.text: WARNING: This app has no autorenewal warning and they aren’t willing to refund your money upon renewal, so set your calendar reminder.  Very disappointing, considering I haven’t opened the app in a year and am out $70 for another year that I won’t use this program.

reviews.title: They Are Difficult
reviews.text: Not only are the workouts/yoga flows and meditations subpar, they also give Super Bad customer service. There is nothing worse than a company who doesn’t value its customers. Maybe you can get away with it now-a-days, screwing people over under the radar - but honestly, investing in people or companies like this only lands you in the same place. And the money is not worth it for what they are offering. Such a disappointment and waste of my time and energy.

reviews.title: Get consent
reviews.text: Took £102 without my consent. Check out the many other customers with this issue. They then refuse to refund it. Beware.

reviews.title: Unethical subscription service
reviews.text: Greedy subscription service, you will not get a reminder that your subscription will renew. I did not want to renew. I noticed the day they charged me, I contacted them for a refund and they wouldn’t refund me = Bad business

reviews.title: Charged £102 after cancelling!
reviews.text: As per other reviews this company has taken £102 from PayPal account a year after cancellation and refused to refund it even though I have not used the app.  It’s a scam of hiding information and slipping in charges without prior notification.  They set up a pre-approved payment in your PayPal account without your knowledge.  I never even knew it existed until today when I saw the charge.  What a total scam.  Disgusting they should do this.

reviews.title: Total Scam
reviews.text: Pretty pictures… no substance…. Cancelled subscription and keeps billing

reviews.title: Fraud
reviews.text: This app has continued to charge me for YEARS after I cancelled my subscription. It managed to charge me on a credit card for an account that should be closed and I now have Kate fees and a bill 5 years later! Do not sign up!

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: Predatory billing practices. Will suddenly increase price and auto-bill you for renewals without notifying you a renewal is coming up. Refuse to refund. The yoga poses are boring and basic, did not result in the improvements they promised.

reviews.title: Scam app alert!
reviews.text: I haven’t used or updated the app in nearly a year, and today, without any notification or heads up of any sort, they have charged me $119.99. They are refusing to refund. This is definitely fraudulent and I will be reporting this app.
